items.why_it_matters: This lesson may help with IT operations work.

practical_action.title: Write proof of one IT skill
steps: Choose one SQL, automation, or IT skill you use at work.
Write the problem, your action, and the result.
Add one number that proves the result.
practical_action.expected_result: A short skill example backed by a real result.
practical_action.test: Another manager understands what you did and why it helped.
practical_action.safety: Remove staff names, account data, and private system details.

practical_action.title: Write an AI content check
steps: Choose one sample AI answer about an IT topic.
Check its source, date, and main fact.
Write pass or fail beside each check.
practical_action.expected_result: A three point check for AI written IT content.
practical_action.test: Another technician gets the same pass or fail result.
practical_action.safety: Treat the AI answer as a draft until a person checks it.

steps: Choose one long IT task an agent handles.
Write the facts, work done, and next step the agent must save.

practical_action.title: Add one human approval stop
steps: Choose one planned AI or automation task.
Mark the step where a wrong result would cause harm.
Require a named person to approve the result at that step.
practical_action.expected_result: One safer workflow with a clear approval owner.
practical_action.test: The workflow stops before any system or data change.
practical_action.safety: Do not let an agent change a live system on its own.

items.why_it_matters: This lesson may help with automation and AI agents work.

practical_action.title: Choose a workflow or an agent
steps: Choose one repeated IT task.
Mark each step as fixed or needing judgment.
Use a simple workflow when every step is fixed. Use an agent only for judgment steps.
practical_action.expected_result: A clear choice between a simple workflow and an AI agent.
practical_action.test: Another technician reaches the same choice from your step list.
practical_action.safety: Do not build or connect the tool until a person reviews the choice.
